'''Zone Five''' was a district of [[Gallisport]], a [[City/Legends|city]] on the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Shesharile 5]]. It was a heavy industrial zone with low-cost residential units. During the [[Galactic Civil War/Legends|Galactic Civil War]], the [[Spiders]] [[Swoop gang/Legends|swoop gang]] ruled Zone Five.
